import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name, color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.45):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name, loc, size, material, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        mod = o.modifiers.new('Rounded edges', 'BEVEL')
        mod.width = bevel
        mod.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def rod(name, a, b, radius, material):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=24, radius=radius, depth=(b-a).length, location=(a+b)/2)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    mod = o.modifiers.new('Edge rounding', 'BEVEL')
    mod.width = 0.012
    mod.segments = 2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def label(body, loc, size, material):
    bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=loc, rotation=(math.pi/2, 0, 0))
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = 'Sign: ' + body
    o.data.body = body
    o.data.align_x = 'CENTER'
    o.data.align_y = 'CENTER'
    o.data.size = size
    o.data.extrude = 0.001
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o

def area(name, loc, energy, size, target):
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.data.energy = energy
    o.data.shape = 'DISK'
    o.data.size = size
    o.rotation_euler = (Vector(target)-o.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()

import bpy, math, random

def mat(name, color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.45):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color,1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name, loc, size, material, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name

    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:

        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 3

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name,color,metallic=0.0,roughness=0.4):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color=(*color,1)
    m.use_nodes=True
    p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=roughness
    return m

def box(name,loc,size,material,bevel=0.0,parent=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1)
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name=name
    o.dimensions=size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        b=o.modifiers.new('Precision rounded edges','BEVEL')
        b.width=bevel
        b.segments=4
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    if parent:
        o.parent=parent
    o.location=loc
    return o

def cylinder(name,loc,radius,depth,material,rotation=(0,0,0),parent=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=48,radius=radius,depth=depth)
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name=name
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if parent:
        o.parent=parent
    o.location=loc
    o.rotation_euler=rotation
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth=True
    b=o.modifiers.new('Edge chamfer','BEVEL')
    b.width=min(0.012,depth*0.18)
    b.segments=3
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def lettering(body,loc,size,material,parent=None,vertical=False):
    bpy.ops.object.text_add()
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name='Legend '+body
    if parent:
        o.parent=parent
    o.location=loc
    if vertical:
        o.rotation_euler=(math.pi/2,0,0)
    o.data.body=body
    o.data.size=size
    o.data.align_x='CENTER'
    o.data.align_y='CENTER'
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o

def area(loc,energy,size,target):
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.data.energy=energy
    o.data.size=size
    o.rotation_euler=(Vector(target)-o.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name,color,metallic=0.0,roughness=0.4):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color=(*color,1)
    m.use_nodes=True
    p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=roughness
    return m

def box(name,loc,size,material,bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name=name
    o.dimensions=size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        b=o.modifiers.new('Soft edges','BEVEL')
        b.width=bevel
        b.segments=4
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def rod(name,a,b,radius,material):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=40,radius=radius,depth=(b-a).length,location=(a+b)/2)
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name=name
    o.rotation_euler=(b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth=True
    bevel=o.modifiers.new('Machined edge','BEVEL')
    bevel.width=0.012
    bevel.segments=3
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def oval_cylinder(name,x,y,z,depth,ry,rz,material):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=1,depth=depth,location=(x,y,z),rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    o=bpy.context.object
    o.name=name
    o.scale=(rz,ry,1)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    b=o.modifiers.new('Rounded cup edges','BEVEL')
    b.width=0.045
    b.segments=4
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def oval_ring(name,x,y,z,ry,rz,tube_x,tube_rad,material):
    verts=[]
    faces=[]
    n,m=72,16
    for i in range(n):
        t=2*math.pi*i/n
        for j in range(m):
            p=2*math.pi*j/m
            verts.append((x+tube_x*math.sin(p),y+(ry+tube_rad*math.cos(p))*math.cos(t),z+(rz+tube_rad*math.cos(p))*math.sin(t)))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            faces.append((i*m+j,((i+1)%n)*m+j,((i+1)%n)*m+(j+1)%m,i*m+(j+1)%m))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces)
    mesh.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in mesh.polygons:
        p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def band(name,rx,rz,zc,t0,t1,width,thickness,material):
    verts=[]
    faces=[]
    segments=80
    for i in range(segments+1):
        t=t0+(t1-t0)*i/segments
        for radial,y in [(-thickness/2,-width/2),(-thickness/2,width/2),(thickness/2,width/2),(thickness/2,-width/2)]:
            verts.append(((rx+radial)*math.cos(t),y,zc+(rz+radial)*math.sin(t)))
    for i in range(segments):
        for j in range(4):
            faces.append((4*i+j,4*i+(j+1)%4,4*(i+1)+(j+1)%4,4*(i+1)+j))
    faces.extend([(3,2,1,0),(4*segments,4*segments+1,4*segments+2,4*segments+3)])
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces)
    mesh.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    bevel=o.modifiers.new('Comfort edge rounding','BEVEL')
    bevel.width=0.028
    bevel.segments=3
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    for p in mesh.polygons:
        p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def curve(name,points,radius,material):
    data=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    data.dimensions='3D'
    data.resolution_u=20
    data.bevel_depth=radius
    data.bevel_resolution=4
    spline=data.splines.new('BEZIER')
    spline.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for p,co in zip(spline.bezier_points,points):
        p.co=co
        p.handle_left_type='AUTO'
        p.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,data)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o

def beam(name,a,b,width,depth,material):

        p.handle_left_type='AUTO'

    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,data)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o

    for a in [0,math.pi/2,math.pi,3*math.pi/2]:
        xx=x+radius*0.60*math.cos(a)
        zz=z+radius*0.60*math.sin(a)
        rod(name+' cap bolt',(xx,outer+side*0.025,zz),(xx,outer+side*0.039,zz),0.023,metal,16)

# Four distinct three-joint legs. Front knees bend rearward; rear knees forward.
for front in [True,False]:
    for side in [-1,1]:
        tag=('Front' if front else 'Rear')+(' left' if side>0 else ' right')
        hx=0.85 if front else -0.85
        hip=Vector((hx,side*0.66,1.73))
        knee=Vector((hx+(-0.34 if front else 0.34),side*0.84,0.91))
        ankle=Vector((hx+(0.19 if front else -0.19),side*0.90,0.22))
        rod(tag+' shoulder axle',(hx,side*0.37,1.73),(hx,side*0.72,1.73),0.16,metal)
        joint(tag+' hip',hip,side,0.235)
        beam(tag+' upper structural link',hip,knee,0.23,0.20,dark)
        start=hip.lerp(knee,0.20)
        end=hip.lerp(knee,0.79)
        start.y+=side*0.105
        end.y+=side*0.105
        beam(tag+' upper armor',start,end,0.22,0.075,orange)
        joint(tag+' knee',knee,side,0.175)
        beam(tag+' lower leg',knee,ankle,0.145,0.15,metal)
        a=knee.lerp(ankle,0.19)
        b=knee.lerp(ankle,0.79)
        a.y+=side*0.081
        b.y+=side*0.081
        beam(tag+' shin cover',a,b,0.17,0.065,dark)
        # Exposed linear actuator beside each lower link.
        actuator_a=knee+Vector((0.10,side*0.12,-0.08))
        actuator_b=ankle+Vector((0.03,side*0.12,0.10))
        mid=actuator_a.lerp(actuator_b,0.56)
        rod(tag+' actuator barrel',actuator_a,mid,0.055,dark)
        rod(tag+' actuator piston',mid,actuator_b,0.026,metal)
        joint(tag+' ankle',ankle,side,0.105)
        box(tag+' foot chassis',(ankle.x+0.045,ankle.y,0.135),(0.40,0.32,0.16),dark,0.055)
        box(tag+' rubber contact pad',(ankle.x+0.045,ankle.y,0.045),(0.43,0.35,0.09),rubber,0.04)
        for offset in [-0.13,0,0.13]:
            box(tag+' tread block',(ankle.x+0.045+offset,ankle.y,0.025),(0.072,0.37,0.05),rubber,0.014)
        cable(tag+' joint wiring',[hip+Vector((-0.13,-side*0.09,-0.08)),hip.lerp(knee,0.50)+Vector((-0.20,-side*0.11,0)),knee+Vector((-0.12,-side*0.09,0.10))],rubber)
